verdict: Working and close to finished. Last cycle's three-time holdout (the wrong README install path) landed in 8f538dd, so nothing now blocks someone else installing these five extensions - which was the main gap. All 7 JS files pass node --check; no syntax or dependency rot, because there are no dependencies. What is left is one live two-line bug (the Chrome badge click-trap on a site the owner uses), one decision that has waited five reviews (delete the unreachable Goku half, now recommended outright rather than framed as a fork), and three cleanups. The one unresolvable risk is that WAIT_REGEX has never been checked against the real DOM - the queue UI is auth-gated and client-rendered, so only the owner can confirm it. Two of the five tasks from the last two cycles were actually implemented, so this backlog is being worked, not just regenerated.
